europe_now.title: French Curfews and Security Measures
europe_now.summary: French authorities implemented localized curfews and ordered online marketplaces to restrict the resale of stolen goods following a weekend of widespread looting and riots.

sources.headline: French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says

europe_now.title: Severe Weather in Spain
europe_now.summary: Torrential rain across eastern regions of Spain triggered severe flooding, resulting in four fatalities and extensive disruption.

sources.headline: Spain floods kill four as torrential rain inundates eastern regions

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: France implemented localized curfews across Paris and other cities following a weekend of riots and looting. Prime Minister Lecornu reported that the restrictions helped maintain peace overnight.

sources.headline: French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says
Live: Curfews in Paris and other cities helped keep the peace overnight, says French PM

top_stories.title: Severe Weather Impacts in Spain
top_stories.summary: Torrential rain severely impacted eastern regions of Spain, leading to floods that caused four deaths. Emergency services continue to respond to the extensive water damage.
